packages.native_hash_recipe: astis-decoder-logical-run-v1: recursively sort object keys by ordinal ascending order, preserve array order, serialize compact JSON using PowerShell 7.6.5 ConvertTo-Json default string escaping and invariant integer formatting, then SHA256 the UTF-8 bytes without BOM or trailing newline. Hash logical_run_payload exactly. Its complete reconstruction object excludes only the decoder_run_sha256 field to avoid self-reference. The payload pins sole packet RAW/LF hashes, statement hash, all seven semantic slots and complete reconstructed theorem text, output paths and markdown hash, actual observed reader and writer identities/PIDs, and the closure/no-further-writes rule. run.json stores both that payload and its exact canonical preimage string. File byte hashes are separately sealed by CLOSED_LAST.json; neither run.json nor CLOSED_LAST.json is recursively hashed into its own preimage.
